· 현재가($75.43) vs SMA5($69.23)/SMA20($69.11)/SMA50($74.67) — 단기·중기 추세 상회, SMA50 근접.

[모멘텀 지표]

· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (상단 $79.93) — 상단 접근 구간.
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($70.96) — 피벗 S1($62.91) 및 SMA100($66.16) 기반.

[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.31배) — 거래량 위축, 움직임 신뢰도 하락.
· 현 구간 진단 (상승추세) — RSI 회복 및 MACD 개선으로 매수 진입 조건 충족.
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($75.43) vs SMA5 ($69.23)/SMA20 ($69.11)/SMA50 ($74.67) — above short/mid-term trend, near SMA50.
· High position relative to SMA100 ($66.16)/SMA200 ($59.44) — strong mid/long-term trend.
· 52-week position (75.1%) + current price level near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (32.0→57.1) — exited oversold, settling in neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.3741→1.0976) — shifted from weak to strong, signaling trend reversal.
· Bollinger Bands current price position (Upper $79.93) — approaching upper band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($70.96) — based on Pivot S1 ($62.91) and SMA100 ($66.16).
· Swing resistance ($79.68) — potential for further upside towards 52-week high ($88.09) upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) — uptrend continuation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.31x) — subdued volume, reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) — buy entry conditions met with RSI recovery and MACD improvement.
